notes.title: The new 55 re-world with a map of the Earth is launched
The 2nd continent in the 8th double-speed-world is opened for registration. 1.4.41 Inside
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/cb58f10e8baad2707f5a3e3517fbee2b0d254479.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/75108d58ab6f8766acac59d78d2f575288e1d236.gif
Kazakhstania is already https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png waiting for you..............More info https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/5286f4a9f6e3c822d3ddd29866f781793b8d4668.png

And in the meantime a curious update 1.4.41 has been released.
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/2565eb2ee57a8ca1324f78a90c0d8ec57da2cf90.png

Gloomy Morgenstern and Bloody Robodog are available to be trained in cities
They are truly dangerous in a battle...


There is a description of a fresh new world below, that has just been opened. 

But at first a few bright combat screenshots.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6af01f3b1f9ef4f7715274a28000c9bcbb94d132.png

They for sure do not reflect the full intensity of the game...
From the Stone Age to the present times!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/a52c4be48587f78d587c1fab80432c9eb05412c0.png

Hundreds of buildings and unit types, 4 races, hours of battle in a real time!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/e47f1dd5809b1eb0473301ab4c9d56c9911cb725.png

But, nevertheless, please the eye and hint that it will be extremely interesting ...


And now the promised description of the new 8th world ...

The first country which puts SS on course wins the world.


The 1st continent Gondwana is opened for registration. All climate zones except snow are available.
The 2nd continent will have only grasslands and snow;
The 3rd: all climate zones (but very little of prairie);

The following parameters are decreased https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png:

 Amount of troops given as a reward for tasks
 Amount of troops at barbarian cities that appear after certain tasks are fulfilled

notes.title: Version 1.4.39 - changelist tweaked
Version 1.4.39 - changelist tweaked
Battle system - a Big Update
notes.content:
A big update of the battle system is being prepared for implementation.

Many aspects were improved and reworked, especially graphics, and also rebalanced.

No clear date for the patch is defined, but the update will be ready to be checked out in the combat simulators of all existing worlds soon! Tick the checkbox "New battle system" (if there is one).

As always, bug reports are appreciated.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/fa54cf91a2ddcd639e5772d09e9ab6e80bc53d47.png

The 6th International game world is coming! (UPDATED)
notes.content:
Estimated launch date - 1 September.
Estimated launch time - 16:00 (UTC)

For this world, winners are defined per ratings.

The speed of all processes is doubled. The parameters to be changed for this world are the following:

 production speed - 2x
 buildings maintenance - 2x
 constructing speed - 2x
 troops speed - 2x
 troops costs - 2x
 troops maintenance - 4x
 efficiency of "Cutthroats" - 2x
 efficiency of "Demolishers" - 2x
 traps damage before a battle - 2x
 carrying capacity of troops - 2x
 population growth - 2x
 rate of consumption by population - 2x
 merchants speed - 2x
 chances to get a Great Citizen - 2x

The following parameters are decreased twice:
 travel time of workers and settlers when sent on a mission
 amount of troops given as a reward for tasks
 amount of troops at barbarian cities that appear after certain tasks are fulfilled
 time of protection after registration

The launch date might be corrected. Stay tuned!
